chapter.title: Act II: The Long Days
subtitle: Summer, Year One
Make summer's abundance usable - power the workshop, work the lake, and float the lanterns.
Forty lamps. Fifteen people. One winter that nobody leaves.

hover: The stream drops. The wind does not.

quests.title: Trade With the Frog Folk in the Reeds
quests.subtitle: Marnie's compass is already set to it.
description: Marnie: "Four minutes past the reeds. Wisp already set the waystone, so you only walk it once."
Follow Marnie's &bExplorer's Compass&r to the Ribbit village and bring back 4 &aRed Toadstools&r. The merchant frog sells them, and they grow in the planters along the boardwalk.
Wisp sends back flower starts and bone meal for Halden's hedge.

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Wisp: ","color":"dark_green"},{"text":"You come back soon, yes? I keep the good toadstools for the walking-friend.","italic":true}]
title @p times 10 70 20
title @p subtitle {"text": "Eleven Ribbits and no roof for winter.", "color": "gray", "italic": true}
title @p title {"text": "The Reed Village", "color": "gold"}
execute at @p run playsound minecraft:ui.toast.challenge_complete master @p ~ ~ ~ 1 1

rewards.title: A Friend in the Reeds
rewards.description: Next: Halden wants 8 poppies, 8 dandelions and 8 cornflowers.

quests.title: Talk to the Woman Fixing the Beached Boat
quests.subtitle: Four years on the same boat.
description: Nella: "It doesn't need fixing, and I know that. I'm fixing it anyway."
Follow the marker down to the lake and right-click &bNella Brightwater&r. She hands you her token; hand it in here.
Nella stays at the lake, and the pasture outline goes in behind the barn with its fence kit and crates.

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Nella: ","color":"aqua"},{"text":"Lake's yours too, then. Don't fall in on your first day.","italic":true}]
/bossbar set valley:folk value 6
title @p times 10 70 20
title @p subtitle {"text": "Nella has been fixing it for four years.", "color": "gray", "italic": true}
title @p title {"text": "The Beached Boat", "color": "gold"}
execute at @p run playsound minecraft:ui.toast.challenge_complete master @p ~ ~ ~ 1 1

rewards.title: Nella Stays at the Lake
rewards.description: Next: catch 10 fish and cook one in the Skillet.

quests.title: Catch 10 Fish and Cook One in the Skillet
quests.subtitle: Any ten fish, then one cooked cod.
description: Nella: "Ten, any ten. The lake isn't fussy and neither am I."
Cast the &aIron Rod&r from the shore until ten fish are in the boat, then cook one cod on a &aSkillet&r and hand the cooked cod in. Nothing counts the ten for you: tick the box yourself.
Rods, baits and every fish in the lake: the &6Animals & Fishing&r chapter.

tasks.title: Ten fish caught (tick this yourself — honour system)

rewards.title: Nella's hat fits you
rewards.description: Next: pull the dredge net eight times from her boat.

quests.title: Bring Halden 24 Flowers for the Hedge Garden
quests.subtitle: Poppies, dandelions, cornflowers - 8 each.
description: Halden: "Nothing in a hedge garden is urgent. That is more or less the entire argument for having one."

Plant Wisp's three starts in the window boxes, then bone-meal the grass on the flat by the &bTown Anchor&r until you have 8 &apoppies&r, 8 dandelions and 8 cornflowers. Carry all 24 to Halden on the south slope.
The hedge garden opens to the town, the spring above it starts running, and the trellis comes down the hill with him.

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Halden: ","color":"green"},{"text":"Josie planted the first hedge here. I only ever kept it trimmed. That can change now.","italic":true}]
/tellraw @a [{"text":"Halden: ","color":"green"},{"text":"You found the door under her kitchen, then. I know what it says and who wrote it. Not on a summer afternoon.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: The Hedge Garden Opens
rewards.description: Next: put the trellis up on the south terrace and plant the 4 grape starts.

quests.title: Put Up the Trellis and Plant 4 Grape Starts
quests.subtitle: 8 lattice panels, 4 starts, two waterings.
description: Halden: "South slope, morning sun, out of the wind. Josie argued with me about this spot for nine years."
Place the 8 &alattice panels&r on the marked terrace, plant the 4 grape starts along the base, water them twice, and hand in one &aRed Grape&r when they fruit.
The press and the barrel come with them. Wine, tea and everything else that boils: the &6Cooking & Brewing&r chapter.

tasks.title: Trellis up, 4 starts planted, watered twice

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Halden: ","color":"green"},{"text":"She was right about the slope. Don't tell her.","italic":true}]

quests.title: Fence the Pasture, Let Out 2 Cows and 2 Sheep
quests.subtitle: Every fence block behind the barn is marked.
description: Pip: "I already named the sheep, both of them. One is Cloud and one is Also Cloud."
Put an &aoak fence&r on every marked block behind the barn, hang the two gates in the gaps, then right-click both Cow Crates and both Sheep Crates inside the fence.
Wool and milk start here, and Oda's third notice wants 8 of that wool at the end of the act.

tasks.title: 2 cows and 2 sheep inside the fenced pasture

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Pip: ","color":"red"},{"text":"THE PASTURE IS OPEN. I am telling everyone. I am telling the duck first.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: Cloud and Also Cloud
rewards.description: Next: help fit out Wisp's stilt house over the shallows.

quests.title: Pull Nella's Dredge Net Eight Times
quests.subtitle: Eight pulls, 16 Lake Sand a pull.
description: Nella: "Sit down, hold the rope, don't help. You never get in the water on my boat."
Sit in Nella's boat over the shallows - or wade in from the shore - and use the &aDredge Net&r eight times. Hand in 128 &aLake Sand&r; the quest hands all 128 straight back.
Lake Sand is the only road to Washed Silica, and Bram's workshop is waiting on it.

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Nella: ","color":"aqua"},{"text":"A hundred and twenty-eight. Take it to Bram before he asks me twice.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: 128 Sand on the Pier
rewards.description: Next: wash the 128 into 64 Washed Silica - eight sand and a water bucket make four.

quests.title: Talk to the Prospector at the Copper Outcrop
quests.subtitle: Nobody has read his survey.
description: Tobin: "You're the Kettle one - right, okay. The seam doesn't stop at the outcrop, it turns, and nobody believes me."
Walk up to the copper outcrop on the hillside and right-click &bTobin Gale&r. He hands you his token; hand it in here.
Tobin moves into the valley with his pick and three survey maps already marked. He is right about all of it.

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Tobin: ","color":"yellow"},{"text":"Six spots. I marked them. I marked them twice actually, sorry, the second set is in pink.","italic":true}]
/bossbar set valley:folk value 7
title @p times 10 70 20
title @p subtitle {"text": "Tobin paced it twice and has not slept.", "color": "gray", "italic": true}
title @p title {"text": "The Copper Outcrop", "color": "gold"}
execute at @p run playsound minecraft:ui.toast.challenge_complete master @p ~ ~ ~ 1 1

rewards.title: Tobin Has an Audience
rewards.description: Next: strike all 6 of Tobin's marked spots with the prospector's pick.

quests.title: Use Tobin's Pick on All 6 Marked Spots
quests.subtitle: He marked them twice, in two colours.
description: Tobin: "Hit the sample, read the sample. If it says copper it means copper is under you, not near you - under you."
Take the &aprospector's pick&r to the 6 spots on Tobin's maps and right-click each one. The sixth reading is the copper cluster.
Copper and tin get pinned to your maps. How deep each bed sits: the &6Ores & Mining&r chapter.

tasks.title: All 6 marked spots struck with the prospector's pick

rewards.command: give @p minecraft:diamond_pickaxe{Enchantments:[{id:"minecraft:efficiency",lvl:4}],display:{Name:'{"text":"The Adit Pick","italic":false,"color":"gold"}'}} 1
/tellraw @a [{"text":"Tobin: ","color":"yellow"},{"text":"Copper here, tin two ridges over. I said that in April. Anyway. Anyway!","italic":true}]
/tellraw @a [{"text":"Tobin: ","color":"yellow"},{"text":"Grass on that slope comes up three weeks early every year and I do not have a rock that explains it.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: Copper and Tin, Pinned
rewards.description: Next: dig out Tobin's adit, once the autumn work starts.

quests.title: Put a Bearing and 8 Sails on the Mill Roof
quests.subtitle: The 16 wool is in Bram's crate.
description: Bram: "Stream drops every August and the wheel stops with it. Wind doesn't drop - put it on the roof."
Craft one &aWindmill Bearing&r and 8 &aWhite Sails&r and hold them to hand in, then set the bearing in the marked roof slot and the eight sails on its shaft.
A second Encased Fan comes with the gear kit. Cogs, belts and the rest: the &6Create&r chapter.

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Bram: ","color":"gray"},{"text":"Turns in a breeze. Good. Now it's a workshop, not a mill.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: The Mill Runs on Wind
rewards.description: Next: wash Nella's 128 Lake Sand into 64 Washed Silica under the fan.

quests.title: Wash Lake Sand Into 64 Washed Silica
quests.subtitle: 128 sand makes exactly 64.
description: Bram: "Fan over running water, sand on the belt underneath. Wash it twice if it still looks like a beach."
Eight &aLake Sand&r and one water bucket make four &aWashed Silica&r on any bench - sixteen batches, and the 128 on the pier is exactly the 64 asked for.
Or build it: an &bEncased Fan&r blowing down through running water washes sand one for one, no buckets at all.

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Bram: ","color":"gray"},{"text":"That's the stuff Josie kept writing about. I never worked out where she got it.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: 64 Silica, and 64 More
rewards.description: Next: craft your first Thermal Machine Frame from Josie's schematic.

quests.title: Craft Your First Thermal Machine Frame
quests.subtitle: Four tin, four glass, one silica.
description: Bram: "Her drawing, her handwriting, and I couldn't make it work in thirty years. You have the sand, so try."
Craft one &aThermal Machine Frame&r: 4 tin ingots and 4 glass around 1 &aWashed Silica&r. Thermal's own frame recipe still works too - either road counts.
Every Thermal machine is that frame with a coil under it: the &6Thermal&r chapter.

rewards.title: Josie's schematic works
rewards.description: Next: fit the workshop with 6 drawers, a controller and 3 barrels.

quests.title: Fit the Workshop With Drawers and Barrels
quests.subtitle: Six drawers, a controller, three barrels.
description: Bram: "Bench first, machines after. A man who can't find his tin ends up mining it twice."
Craft and hold 6 &aOak Full Drawers&r, 1 &aDrawer Controller&r and 3 Sophisticated Barrels, then set them along the long wall of the mill's back room.
One controller makes six drawers one inventory. More of that in &6Power & Logistics&r.

rewards.title: The Long Bench
rewards.description: Next: build a Thermal Pulverizer and run 32 iron ore through it.

quests.title: Run 32 Iron Ore Through a Pulverizer
quests.subtitle: The Stirling Dynamo burns charcoal.
description: Bram: "Two dust out of one ore. That's not a trick, that's just knowing what a hammer is for."
Build a &aThermal Pulverizer&r on the machine frame and stand the &aStirling Dynamo&r against its input face - it burns what the bread oven burns. Run 32 iron ore through and hand in the dust.
Ore is doubled from here on, and the second dynamo is what lights the first two posts.

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Bram: ","color":"gray"},{"text":"Well.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: Ore is doubled forever
rewards.description: Next: run duct out to four dark posts between the mill and the square.

quests.title: Light Four Lamp Posts, Mill to Square
quests.subtitle: They have stood dark for eleven years.
description: Oda: "Six lamps lit, thirty-four dark. I count them every night whether I mean to or not."

All forty posts are already standing - Josie put them there. Run &aEnergy Duct&r from the Stirling Dynamo out to the four marked posts between the mill and the square, and light two. The &cRedstone Furnace&r eats power; leave it off this line.
Lamps 10 of 40, and nothing hostile spawns along the lit stretch.

tasks.title: 4 posts on their marks, 2 of them lit off the dynamo

rewards.command: /bossbar set valley:lamps value 10
/tellraw @a [{"text":"Oda: ","color":"gold"},{"text":"Ten. Write it in the ledger. I want it in ink.","italic":true}]
/tellraw @a [{"text":"Bram: ","color":"gray"},{"text":"Third one leans. I straightened it twice and Josie would not let me dig it out. Leave it now.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: Lamps 10 / 40
rewards.description: Next: the rest of the road, mill to square to lake, in Act IV.

quests.title: Fit Out Wisp's Stilt House Over the Shallows
quests.subtitle: Every spot on the decking is marked.
description: Wisp: "Two places is too many places for one person. I would like to be in the one place, with you lot. Please can I?"
From the crate on the decking: a mossy oak post on each of the 6 marks, the bed on the wool mat, the door in the doorway, a window in each hole, the 3 &aswamp lanterns&r on their hooks.
Wisp moves into town, marsh trade opens, and Oda's stockroom sends the paper for the Float.

tasks.title: 6 posts, bed, door, 2 windows and 3 lanterns on their marks

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Wisp: ","color":"dark_green"},{"text":"Now the marsh and the town is one place. I always said it was one place.","italic":true}]
/bossbar set valley:folk value 8
title @p times 10 70 20
title @p subtitle {"text": "Over the shallows, on four good legs.", "color": "gray", "italic": true}
title @p title {"text": "Wisp's Stilt House", "color": "gold"}
execute at @p run playsound minecraft:ui.toast.challenge_complete master @p ~ ~ ~ 1 1

rewards.title: Wisp lives here now
rewards.description: Next: craft 24 paper lanterns with Marnie and Pip.

quests.title: Craft 24 Paper Lanterns With Marnie and Pip
quests.subtitle: Eight paper around one torch, six times.
description: Marnie: "Nella says nobody will come, and Nella has made forty of these. Draw your own conclusions, love."
Eight paper around one torch makes four &aPaper Lanterns&r - six batches for 24. Oda's stockroom already put the 48 sheets and 24 torches in your bag.
These are the ones that go on the water at the Float.

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Pip: ","color":"red"},{"text":"I made TWO HUNDRED. Marnie says twenty-four. I made two hundred.","italic":true}]
/tellraw @a [{"text":"Marnie: ","color":"light_purple"},{"text":"Josie lit this road one February — eleven nights, soup warm the whole way up the lane — and I never asked why.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: Pip's Two Hundred
rewards.description: Next: fill Oda's three notices — 24 wheat, 8 cooked fish, 8 wool.

quests.title: Fill Oda's Three Notices - Wheat, Fish, Wool
quests.subtitle: Act II finale - the Lantern Float.
description: Oda: "Three notices on the board and all three get filled the same week. That has not happened since Josie."
Take 24 wheat off your fields, 8 &acooked cod&r off Nella's lake and 8 &awhite wool&r off Cloud and Also Cloud, and hand all three notices in at the board outside the store.
Then the whole town walks down to the water. Forty lamps. Fifteen people. One winter that nobody leaves.

rewards.command: /valley finale act2

rewards.title: The Lantern Float
rewards.description: Next: Oda opens the ledger and counts the town's stores for winter.
